questions.question: Monalisa is standing in a row, which contains total 45 people. If Monalisa is 27th from left end and Rakhi is 12th from right end. Then what is the ratio between the Monalisa’s position from right end to the Rakhi’s position from left end?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Total number of people = 45

Monalisa is 27th from the left end.

So, Place of Monalisa from the right end = 45 - 27 + 1 = 19.

Rakhi is 12th from the right end.

So, Place of Rakhi from the right end = 45 - 12 + 1 = 34.

Now, the ratio between Monalisa’s position from the right end to Rakhi’s position from the left end is:- 19 : 34

Hence, the correct answer is **"19 : 34"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

According to the given information:

Total number of people = 45

Monalisa is 27th from the left end.

Rakhi is 12th from the right end.

So, total students 27 + 12 = 39

Hence, overlapping does not occur in this case.

The number of people between them = 45 – 39 = 6

So, we get - 26 (Monalisha) 6 (Rakhi) 11.

Therefore, Monalisa’s position from right end = 45 – 26 = 19

Rakhi’s position from left end = 45 – 11 = 34

Ratio between them = 19: 34

questions.question: Kiran starts from Point A and drives 4 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 5 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 17 km, takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He then turns left, drives 8 km and stops at Point B. questions.solution:
As per the given information, the movement of Kiran is shown in the figure below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ff06d3a0028be0ae3ca94e33fe243b918fba43f0395ef7cddc4db0f2a34c8b.png] 

AP = 4 km. PQ = 9 km. QR = 5 km. RS = 17 km. ST = 14 km. TB = 8 km.

So, as per the above figure, the required distance BA is,

BA = 14 - (4 + 5) ⇒ 14 - 9 = 5 km.

So, Kiran should drive 5 Km towards the east to reach point A from point B.

Hence the correct answer is, "**5 km towards the east**".

options.text: Both I and II are implicit.

questions.solution:

Hence, assumption I is implicit.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements are true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All guavas are bananas.

All pumpkins are bananas.

All bananas are plums.

**Conclusions:**

1. All pumpkins are plum.

2. All plums are guavas.

3. Some plums are pumpkins.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d92b052b4f2467270eff69e774def20ebc84d0484d406a8a3162f07ad4502c34.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All pumpkins are plum. → True (As all pumpkins are bananas and all bananas are plum).

2. All plums are guavas. → False (It is possible but not definite).

3. Some plums are pumpkins. → True (As all pumpkins are bananas and all bananas are plum).

Hence, **Only conclusions 1 and 3 follow.**

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Q is sitting on the immediate left of S.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: A Man has four silver articles, P, Q, R and S, each having a different weight. P weights trice as much as Q. Q weighs two and a half times as much as S, R weighs half as much as S. Which of the following silver article is the lightest in weight?
questions.solution:
**Four silver articles** - P, Q, R and S, each having a different weight.

Let the weights of S = x

1) R weighs half as much as S.

Therefore, the weight of R = 0.5x

2) Q weighs two and a half times as much as S.

Therefore the weight of Q = 2.5x

3) P weights trice as much as Q.

Therefore the weight of P = 3 × 2.5x = 7.5x

Arrangement from heaviest to lowest:

P (7.5x) > Q (2.5x) > S (x) > R (0.5x)

Clearly, R is the silver article which is the lightest in weight.

Hence, ‘**R**’ is the correct answer.
